messages:
incident-bot: pagerduty triggered: HIGH latency (p99 > 2000ms) for inference-api.prod.us-east-1 — incident: PD-43218, runbook: /runbooks/latency-p99
pagerduty: page fired to @jon (primary), escalation to @sara in 8m
jon: acked. looking now. seeing a coincident spike in request queue depth and batch time. :thinking:
miguel: on it if you need me — checking autoscaler logs and recent deploys
ellie: support notified, creating internal ticket and flagging customers that hit >2s responses in last 15m
jon: quick check: model variant rollout 2026-03-17T09:02 UTC — canary showed higher tail. tagging rollout for rollback consideration
miguel: autoscaler telemetry: scale decisions delayed, kube HPA flapping on sidecar metrics. suspect sidecar CPU saturation. grabbing pod logs
jon: logs show repeated OOMKill on sidecar-proxy-2: ```Mar 17 09:04:12 sidecar-proxy[pid]: OOMKilled, RSS 1.9G, mem.limit 2G
Mar 17 09:04:13 serving: request queue len=120, avg batch ms=420
```
jon: mitigation plan: 1) pause model rollout 2) bump sidecar memory limit on hot pods 3) route heavy customers to fallback model (smaller) 4) scale up dedicated pool as short-term capacity add
sara: i'm on-call standby, will take bridge if we escalate. jon — handover in 10m if still active
miguel: bumping memory on two pods now: `kubectl patch deployment sidecar-proxy -p '\"spec:\"{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"containers\":[{\"name\":\"sidecar-proxy\",\"resources\":{\"limits\":{\"memory\":\"3Gi\"}}}]}}}'` — rolling restart underway :spinner:
jon: paused rollout via jobs-service API: `POST /api/rollouts/20260317/pause` — confirmed paused. initiating routing change to fallback model for top 10 customers (policy: latency-first)
ellie: support: sending proactive note to 3 customers who had failures — staging template in #support-dm, will paste status page link once updated
miguel: autoscaler override applied: provisioned +4 GPUs in dedicated pool, should be in by 09:12 UTC; also cleared OOMs on restarted sidecar pods
jon: monitoring: p95 back down to ~420ms, p99 trending down from 2.3s to 1.6s. still above SLO but improving — tracking in dashboard: https://dash.redwood.team/d/latency/p99-burn
sara: taking active bridge. jon -> miguel -> sara handoff: jon keep monitoring, miguel stay on infra changes, i'll coordinate communications and PD escalation if needed
support-lead: please add incident severity and customer-impact summary to PD ticket PD-43218: affected customers: 3 customers had >2s responses, no data loss, transient errors retried by client, support notified
jon: will follow up with postmortem ops list: immediate cause = model rollout + sidecar mem limit + autoscaler hysteresis. proposed next actions: conservative canary checks, increase sidecar mem limit by default, autoscaler smoothing, prewarming kv-cache for new variants
ellie: support note sent, status.redwood.ai updated: "Degraded latency in inference-api (US-East). Mitigations in progress."
miguel: verifying no regressions from memory bump — running loadcheck against canary region now
sara: if p99 hits <1s for 20m we will close pagerduty. otherwise escalate PD-43218 to urgent and loop on-call SRE rota for deeper dive
jon: ack. will post final status and timeline in 20m. :thumbsup:
